candidates.claim: The new lemma `Meromorphic.sub` is just the `MeromorphicOn.sub` lemma applied to `U := Set.univ` (and converting `Meromorphic` to `MeromorphicOn` by ignoring the membership proof), so it duplicates existing API rather than adding new content.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
@[fun_prop]
lemma sub (hf : Meromorphic f) (hg : Meromorphic g) :
    Meromorphic (f - g) := by
  intro x
  simpa [Meromorphic] using (MeromorphicOn.sub (U := Set.univ) (f := f) (g := g)
    (hf := fun y _ => hf y) (hg := fun y _ => hg y) x (by simp))

candidates.requested_change: Replace the proof of `Meromorphic.sub` with a one-liner proof via `MeromorphicOn.sub` (specialized to `Set.univ`) to avoid duplicating a parallel implementation.

candidates.claim: The new lemma `Meromorphic.div` is a specialization of the existing `MeromorphicOn.div` (on `U := Set.univ`), so it adds a duplicated lemma implementation rather than new capability.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
@[fun_prop]
lemma div {f g : 𝕜 → 𝕜} (hf : Meromorphic f) (hg : Meromorphic g) :
    Meromorphic (f / g) := by
  intro x
  simpa [Meromorphic] using (MeromorphicOn.div (U := Set.univ) (s := f) (t := g)
    (hs := fun y _ => hf y) (ht := fun y _ => hg y) x (by simp))
